findings.claim: docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020d2/DISPATCH-NOTE.md is silent about the CORR2-004 post-merge correction to scripts/configure-020d2-required-check.sh. The correction — removing `required_signatures: true` from the unified PUT body and adding a dedicated `gh api -X POST .../required_signatures` call — was a substantive bug fix discovered during 020G R2 review and applied as part of fix-round-2. The 020D2 DISPATCH-NOTE was authored before this bug was surfaced and has not been amended with a post-merge correction section. An auditor tracing the 020D2 slice via its canonical dispatch artefact will find no record of the correction and must independently discover 020G FIX-ROUND-2.md CORR2-004 to understand the current script state.
findings.evidence: configure-020d2-required-check.sh lines 107-116 carry the inline closure comment: 'Closes 020G R2 correctness CORR2-004: required_signatures is NOT a documented field of the unified branch-protection PUT body — it's a dedicated sub-resource.' FIX-ROUND-2.md CORR2-004 entry: 'closed — removed `required_signatures: true` from `configure-020d2-required-check.sh` unified PUT body; added separate `gh api -X POST .../required_signatures` call.' docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020d2/DISPATCH-NOTE.md: no 'Post-merge correction' section, no CORR2-004 reference, no mention of required_signatures endpoint change.
findings.impact: The estate pattern requires each slice's dispatch artefact to be sufficient for its own audit without requiring cross-slice lookup. The 020D2 DISPATCH-NOTE as-is fails this requirement: the acceptance checklist implies the unified PUT is the only required_signatures mechanism, which is now incorrect. A future operator re-applying 020D2 from the DISPATCH-NOTE alone cannot reconcile the 'accepted' state with the corrected script without serendipitous discovery of the cross-slice fix-round document.
findings.mitigation: Add a 'Post-merge correction' section to docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020d2/DISPATCH-NOTE.md noting: 'During 020G R2 review (CORR2-004, filed 2026-04-30), a latent bug was identified in configure-020d2-required-check.sh: `required_signatures: true` was present in the unified PUT body, which does not carry this field per the GitHub branch-protection API. The field was removed from the PUT body and replaced with a dedicated `gh api -X POST .../required_signatures` call (idempotent). SCP-self already had required_signatures enabled via 020J's separate call, so the prior shape was a latent bug rather than an operational failure. See docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020g/FIX-ROUND-2.md CORR2-004 for full detail.'
